integrity: Analytic proof and exact rational polynomial verification. Historical-priority uncertainty remains regarding inaccessible sections of a closely related 2010 RKDG stability analysis. No external independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact contractivity applies only to degree-one unmodified upwind DG for periodic uniform one-dimensional linear constant-speed transport with standard SSPRK(3,3), exact integration, and the physical L2 norm; not higher-order DG, nonlinear entropies or arbitrary nonuniform meshes.
title: Sharp one-step \(L^2\) contractivity CFL for \(\mathbb P^1\) upwind DG with SSPRK3
